verification_scope: Sixteen current official operator or official public-owner sources for England retail and mixed-use destinations were checked in parallel for predominant use, jurisdiction, address and operational scope evidence.

source_readback.evidence: The current official St Stephen's site presents shops, restaurants and cinema functions within the Hull destination and maintains an active retailer directory.
The current official Victoria Centre site lists fashion, beauty, technology and food operators, visitor facilities, events and parking in Nottingham city centre.

The current official Freshney Place directory lists active retail and service operators, while official visitor information identifies the Grimsby town-centre location and two secure multi-storey car parks.
The current official Waterside pages publish an active store directory and identify the centre on High Street in Lincoln.
The current official Potteries Centre homepage states that more than 50 shops, seven restaurants and cafes and a nine-screen cinema operate under one roof and publishes the ST1 1PS centre address.

The current official Shrewsbury Shopping pages identify The Darwin Shopping Centre and provide current centre contact information; official town-centre material describes popular fashion, household and cafe operators over three floors.
The current official Saddlers directory lists active stores, cafes and services and identifies Walsall Railway Station as an adjoining centre component.
The current official Cornmill directory lists active shops and places to eat and publishes the Priestgate, Darlington DL1 1NH centre address.
The current official Cleveland Centre site maintains an active all-stores directory and visitor information for the Middlesbrough centre.
The current official Middleton Grange directory lists active stores and current opening times, while centre pages document facilities, parking and the Hartlepool town-centre location.
The current official Spindles site describes The Spindles, The Market and The Loom as three distinct spaces in one connected Oldham destination and publishes Parliament Square OL1 1AS.
The current official Grosvenor Shopping Northampton site provides an active store directory and identifies the centre in the heart of Northampton town centre.
The current official Harpur Centre site maintains an active store directory and publishes the Horne Lane, Bedford MK40 1TJ centre location.
Current official and council pages identify Royal Victoria Place as a multi-level covered Tunbridge Wells shopping centre with active stores and an attached car park.
The current official County Mall directory states that more than 80 retailers and over 200 brands operate under one roof and provides current Crawley visitor information.
The current official Beacon directory lists a broad active retailer mix, food and social functions and publishes the 57 The Beacon, Eastbourne BN21 3NW address.

source_policy: Official sources support classification, England jurisdiction and address or scope evidence only. No canonical parcel identity, title boundary, exact geometry or distance is asserted.
